assertions.description: INCORRECT: The schematic places #FLG01 (PWR_FLAG) at (146.05, 78.74) whose power_out pin is wired to the same node as #PWR02 (GNDREF at 147.32, 78.74) via the wire segment (146.05, 78.74)→(147.32, 78.74). This makes GNDREF a PWR_FLAG-sourced net. However, the analyzer emits a pwr_flag_warnings entry claiming 'Power rail GNDREF has power_in pins but no power_out or PWR_FLAG'. The PWR_FLAG is present but the analyzer is not recognizing it as satisfying the ERC requirement for GNDREF.
assertions.incorrect_review: graduate (TH-105, 2026-11-06): pwr_flag_warnings now []; PWR_FLAG on GNDREF is credited (aspirational lock passes).

assertions.description: INCORRECT: Q1 (PN2222A) is an NPN switch with R2 (1k) as a collector series resistor (pull-up to the supply) and J3 as the output connector. The collector net (__unnamed_2) has R2 and J3 on it. The analyzer reports load_type as 'connector', ignoring the resistor R2 which is the actual load element on the collector. A more accurate load_type would be 'resistor' since R2 is in series on the collector path. The base_resistors field correctly identifies R1 (10k), but the collector load resistor R2 is not captured.

R2 (1k, rotated 180 deg) is the collector pull-up: R2 pin 1 shares a net with Q1's collector and J3 pin 2, and R2 pin 2 is on J2 pin 1 (kicad-cli 10.0.8 netlist agrees). The original finding had the rotated pin positions backwards. The net is unnamed (__unnamed_2).
